title: A new family of instance-level loss functions for improving instance-level segmentation and detection of white matter hyperintensities in routine clinical brain MRI
mechanism: Instance losses: instance segmentation, instance centre, false/missed instance rate, and proximity loss pulling predicted instances to GT instances.
adaptation: Use L_false (soft count of missed + false crack instances) and L_proximity (tolerates 1-2 px offsets) on merged crack instances.
min_experiment: Arm: house + L_false + L_proximity, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: component F1, relF1@2. Kill: no component F1 gain >= 0.02.
evidence: ADNI and WMH challenge: ensemble of two instance losses beats pixel losses on instance metrics; also helps nuclei segmentation.
